plainText:
David Brimmer is an American voice actor and fight choreographer who currently works for the English dub of . He is sometimes credited as Michael Alston Bailey, Michael Alston Baley, David J. Brimmer, or J. David Brimmer.

== Biography ==
Brimmer began portraying characters on the series during the first season. After the 4th season, he ended his tenure with the series, but continued to work with 4Kids Entertainment, presumably until before their bankruptcy. Brimmer returned to the series in Cream of the Croagunk Crop!, voicing Crasher Wake.
